top_paper.title: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
top_paper.summary: The Trinity framework recursively improves multimodal agents by organizing tasks into a capability tree, generating simulated training worlds, and routing specialized harness modules to boost performance on diverse benchmarks.

papers.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
papers.summary: Sensorimotor alignment measures how sensory representations match physical motion geometry, serving as a low-cost offline predictor of robot model performance.

papers.title: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving
papers.summary: TAO improves scheduling for LLM agent services by considering tool readiness and using dynamic programming to place sessions, reducing latency and increasing throughput.

papers.title: OmniShowcase: Omnidirectional Subject-Consistent Video Generation from Multi-View Images
papers.summary: OmniShowcase improves subject-to-video generation by using geometry-driven training data and surface-normal conditioning to maintain 3D consistency across novel viewpoints.

papers.title: Efficient Streaming Audio-Visual Target Speaker Extraction for Real-World Acoustic Scenes
papers.summary: Falcon is a lightweight causal audio-visual target speaker extraction method that achieves high quality with drastically reduced parameters and latency, supported by the realistic RealSSA benchmark.

papers.title: DTCA: Denoising Token Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning in Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary: DTCA improves reinforcement learning for diffusion language models by assigning token-level credit via confidence improvements and entropy calibration, boosting mathematical reasoning.

papers.title: AdaPRA: Process Reward Agents with Adaptive Rubrics for Data Science
papers.summary: AdaPRA improves data science agents via persistent knowledge accumulation and adaptive rubric-guided process supervision, reducing errors and boosting leaderboard performance.

papers.title: Self-Assessment Reinforcement Learning for Search-State Awareness in Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
papers.summary: Self-Assessment Reinforcement Learning trains search agents to recognize missing information and improve search efficiency without extra inference-time assessment.

papers.title: Quaternion Approximate Networks for Enhanced Image Classification and Oriented Object Detection
papers.summary: QUAN is a quaternion-based deep learning framework that approximates quaternion convolution with real-valued operations to achieve rotation-equivariant image classification and object detection with improved efficiency.

papers.title: AlphaBet: Reinforcement Learning for LLM Event Forecasting Agents
papers.summary: AlphaBet uses agentic reinforcement learning to train a single LLM policy to search, reason, and report forecast probabilities across multiple dates, reducing Brier scores by improving both evidence acquisition and probability reporting.

papers.title: Sub-monolayer tracking of molecular states at buried interfaces
papers.summary: Machine learning-enhanced optical modeling of polarized resonant soft X-ray scattering enables quantitative, depth-resolved analysis of molecular orientation and packing at buried interfaces.

papers.title: Lipi-Ghor: A Large-Scale, Diarized, Multi-Domain Bengali Speech Corpus and a Scalable Pipeline for Building It
papers.summary: Lipi-Ghor is a large-scale weakly supervised Bengali speech corpus with speaker-diarized long-form annotations and a gold evaluation split for benchmarking ASR models.

papers.title: Beyond the Estimate: Wiener-Informed Decoding for Easier Training of Pixel-Space Flow Models
papers.summary: Wiener-informed Decoding accelerates pixel-space velocity model training and improves image generation by integrating statistical predictions into decoder computation without altering native blocks.

papers.title: What Outcome RL Buys: Finishing, Reliability, Rarely Reach
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning improves pass@1 mainly by finishing answers faster and increasing reliability rather than acquiring new problem-solving knowledge, with minimal reach gains under fixed token budgets.

papers.title: How Much Does the Hint Matter? Scope Conditions for Hindsight Self-Distillation in Financial Reasoning
papers.summary: Fin-SD improves local multi-step financial reasoning by using self-generated error critiques and truncated correct prefixes for on-policy distillation without external teachers.

papers.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations
papers.summary: EmbeddingGemma 2 is an open multimodal embedding model that unifies text, images, audio, and video representations with efficient resource-flexible design and state-of-the-art benchmark performance.

papers.title: T-DIG: Text-Conditioned Diversity for Image Generation
papers.summary: T-DIG is a text-conditioned diversity framework that uses an LLM policy with reinforcement learning to generate axis-specific image variations via frozen generators, enabling user-directed exploration without model retraining.

papers.title: Multiscale Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.summary: Multiscale Policy Optimization improves long-horizon agent training by aligning credit assignment and policy updates at the turn scale.

papers.title: h1: A Taste of the Bitter Lesson in Automated Theorem Proving
papers.summary: A simple agentic loop with efficient Lean feedback achieves state-of-the-art formal theorem proving without structured workflows, showing that execution interfaces matter more than complex orchestration.

papers.title: The Lexical Imprint of Pre-training Data
papers.summary: Pre-training corpora leave a lexical imprint on zero-shot accuracy that is consistently tracked by word-level unigram cross-entropy across benchmarks, document selection, and prompt routing.

papers.title: Zooming without Zooming v2: From Seeing Details to Connecting Evidence for Generalizable Multimodal Perception
papers.summary: EvidenceConnect synthesizes training data to strengthen visual evidence connection, improving spatial perception and multimodal reasoning across diverse tasks.

papers.title: Can Discrete Tokens Serve as Semantically Lossless Representations of Visual Signals?
papers.summary: Factorized Vector Quantization improves discrete visual token quality by using parallel codebooks on complementary feature views, enabling discrete representations to match continuous ones in multimodal understanding.

papers.title: Truncate or Not? A Scaling Study of Looped Transformers with Truncated Backpropagation
papers.summary: Looped transformers trained with full backpropagation through time outperform truncated alternatives under matched compute, with scaling laws identifying two loops as optimal when model size is adjustable.

papers.title: Rare, Relevant, and Still Wrong: How Memory Fails LLM Group Decisions
papers.summary: When compressing multi-agent discussions for final decisions, memory selection by rarity or relevance both fail due to decoy inclusion and social-proof bias, and even full transcripts reduce accuracy compared to no notes.

papers.title: VibeVideoBench: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation
papers.summary: VibeVideoBench evaluates multimodal agents that generate videos via code, finding that top systems meet core requirements on most tasks but frequently fail due to poor time management.

papers.title: RynnWorld-Latent: A Cross-Embodiment World Model Conditioned on Universal Latent Actions
papers.summary: RynnWorld-Latent learns cross-embodiment world dynamics via 3D-grounded latent actions, enabling joint pretraining on diverse video sources and synthetic data generation for improved robot policy performance.

papers.title: PDRVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Physical Dynamics Representations
papers.summary: PDRVLA improves robot action generation by integrating a lightweight physical dynamics module that predicts future visual features with world-model supervision, avoiding online video generation latency.

papers.title: Your Policy Is Secretly a Harness: The Decision Geometry of Agent Interfaces
papers.summary: Under KL-regularized control, a policy encodes its harness preferences, so deployed performance equals harness potential minus policy mismatch, and harness comparisons must separate these terms to predict training gains.

papers.title: Benchmarking Obstacle-Conditioned Safety in Household Robot Navigation
papers.summary: The study introduces a benchmark and metric to evaluate whether robot navigation policies adapt continuous motion to obstacle safety semantics, revealing a gap in translating semantic caution into safe movement.

papers.title: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
papers.summary: The Trinity framework recursively improves multimodal agents by organizing tasks into a capability tree, generating simulated training worlds, and routing specialized harness modules to boost performance on diverse benchmarks.

papers.title: PhysEvolve: Verifier-grounded Self-evolution for Physical Reasoning with Executable Worlds
papers.summary: Physevolve trains vision-language models in causal physical reasoning by using a physics engine to validate self-generated executable worlds and counterfactual simulations, improving performance on dynamics benchmarks without human data.
